title: Subtract the opening once
hook: A rectangular panel includes a 2m² opening. Counting the outline counts too much surface.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Subtract a stated opening from rectangular coverage area.

misconception: The outer rectangle always equals the area requiring material.
objective: Subtract a stated opening from rectangular coverage area.

claims.text: An ideal panel is 3m high and 4m wide, with one 2m² opening that needs no covering. Scaled model; ideal dimensions; fixed 2m² opening.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Width=4m, A=10m² and B=12m². Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["-",["*","x",3],2]; B=["*","x",3]; x denotes Width. At x=4, A=10, B=12; recall at x=7: B=21. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): disputed; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Multiply width by height for the outline, then subtract the opening’s area once. The outline is a boundary enclosing both material and empty space; it is not automatically the area needing coverage.

recall.question: An ideal panel is 3m high and 4m wide, with one 2m² opening that needs no covering. Change only Width to 7m. What is B (Outline) now?
